exam_name: Competitive Examination for the Post of Stenographer Grade-II (Contract) under Mizoram Public Service Commission

MIZORAM PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
COMPETITIVE EXAMINATION FOR THE POST OF
STENOGRAPHER GRADE-II (CONTRACT)
UNDER MIZORAM PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
(MAY-2025)
PAPER-II
Time Allowed : 2 hours
Full Marks : 100
Pass Marks  :   40
All questions carry equal mark of 1 each.  Attempt all questions.
